data.body:
Patchset 2 pushed on change 1781 (commit 013da02b9c).

CI FAILURE CAUSE (PS1 Verified -1): the cli-reference drift gate — docs/cli-reference.md is DERIVED from the CLI help text, and the new --include-archived usage lines made it stale. Fixed by regenerating with python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py (12 lines).

ADVISORY FOLDS (all 4 LLM-Review findings addressed in the same patchset):
1. (correctness) --include-archived now threads through the repair path too: _repair_run gains include_archived (all 4 _ticket_dirs sites inside it), _run_live_repair and _repair_cli pass it through — 'fsck --repair --include-archived' now repairs what it reports. New test seeds a real SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT fault (re-materialized folded source) in a legacy-archived ticket: default dry-run plans nothing, flagged dry-run plans the retire.
2. (regression) Store-wide metrics stay store-wide: _check_json_validity (per-env authorship tally) and _check_create_events (signed/unsigned presence totals) always walk ALL dirs; include_archived scopes only which findings are REPORTED. Cheap by design: archived tickets are terminally folded, so their walk is snapshot + a few events. New test proves both tallies identical with and without the flag.
3. (error-handling) _terminal_fold captures the failed compact_cli's stdout+stderr and appends it to the CommandError message.
4. (tests) New recovery-contract test: forced fold rc=1 → CommandError propagates carrying the fold's output detail, and NO ARCHIVED event or .archived marker is written.

Also updated the two _ticket_dirs monkeypatch lambdas (repair-pause ownership tests) for the new keyword.

EVIDENCE: test_scan_scoping.py now 13/13 green; +5 targeted mutants on the fold code all KILLED (repair threading dropped, tally walks narrowed x2, error detail dropped, reported-guard inverted) — cumulative 14/14; make lint clean (ratchet new=0 increased=0), make typecheck clean (539 files), adjacent suites 326 passed. Awaiting re-vote on PS2.
